name: Unseelie Hunter (Su)
body:
Benefit: Whenever the magus enhances her weapon using her arcane pool, she may spend 1 additional point from her arcane pool to temporarily infuse that weapon with aetherplasm, causing it to shed light. When the magus hits with the infused weapon the target is affected as if by a faerie fire spell. At 6th level, when the magus hits with the infused weapon, the magus can choose to spend 1 additional point to instead effect the target as if by a glitterdust spell.
